title: The Radio Said My NAME 📻
description:
Every morning, the radio in our kitchen reads out one name, and nobody goes near that person all day. Everybody knows a named day is the worst day of your life, and bad luck is catching.

My whole life, it had never said mine. This Saturday, it did. I still needed oranges.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
